proposals: The Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare should publish one state-wise FPO registry covering every promoting agency, not only SFAC's channel, so the 3,649 SFAC-registered FPOs on this map can be set against the roughly 45,000 FPOs said to exist across India.

The Department of Food and Public Distribution should publish state-wise covered storage capacity by agency and channel in the Foodgrain Bulletin, in a table that sums to the all-India total, so state figures reconcile with the roughly 841 LMT national figure instead of standing as illustrative snapshots.

SFAC should publish, for each FPO formed under the 10,000-FPO scheme, whether it has received the management grant, the equity grant and a credit-guaranteed loan, and whether it filed accounts last year, so the scheme's milestone is measured in working FPOs, not registrations.

The Uttar Pradesh government should publish how much State Warehousing Corporation capacity FPOs can hire, at what rates, and how much they actually used each season, so the state with 758 FPOs and a thin storage footprint can see whether its collectives can hold crop off the market.
